title: Bound fixed-paid Type A rank-17 root splits at two caller windows
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** Check a necessary prefix condition for replacing one Type A rank-17 productive root by ranks 8 and 9 with every paid caller operation fixed. The two role-10 idle-first cuts contain nonzero terms with an empty body mask, so neither admits the required stage-9 factor. All 328 role-7 native-first cuts fail. Of these, 285 have a pure stage-7 body with both central phase parities, and 43 also have a foreign body. Both placements of the odd phase are excluded in the role-7 window. Independent forward and reverse Laurent engines agree on all 330 complete columns. Zero unresolved within scope.

The optimistic one-edit gross ceiling is 4.077730393712098 raw units across 96 Type A ports, with paid stock fixed. The four-root relaxed ceiling is 16.310921574848387 raw. The prefix failures leave no candidate or realized saving in either tested window.

## Task and overlap

Use [#7334](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7334) at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` and signed [#7113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7113) at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. [#7316](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7316) studies rank-137 roots 0 and 18. This package applies exact full-column checks to two rank-17 roots with different caller chronologies. The package is the only new research commit, stacked on the existing [#7257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257) CI commits.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-type-a-rank17-prefix-bound/replay.py
```

Clean replay regenerates the whole-invoice quote and both exact engines' column receipts. Five deterministic receipts agree. Altered caller and price inputs and duplicate path keys reject. Registered replay, committed bytes and modes, source history, navigation and official Git-free export passed locally. Suffix, fresh dirty-owner and physical compiler checks were not reached after prefix failure.

## Credit

#7334 and #7113 supply the literal inputs, #7316 the reverse Laurent method and rank-137 precedent, #7362 the complete price stock, #7298 the directed tariff and #7175 related abstract fixed-profile work. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

Other roots, other role-10 cuts and changed caller factorizations remain open. A candidate must clear the signed prefix and dual suffix before paying for fresh ownership and the complete compiler replay.
